preview.tournamentOverview: Bellerive Country Club hosts the BMW Championship with a course profile that heavily favors off-the-tee play. SG OTT carries the highest weight at 1%, followed by SG Total at 3% and SG Putting at 4%. This event is the second leg of the FedExCup Playoffs, determining the top 30 players who advance to the Tour Championship.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model places the greatest emphasis on SG OTT 1%) and SG Total 3%), reflecting Bellerive's length and rough. SG Putting 4%) and SG Approach 1%) round out the key inputs, while driving accuracy 0%) and bogey avoidance 0%) receive minimal weight. This weighting rewards players who gain strokes off the tee and maintain strong overall ball-striking.
preview.pickApproach: We tier bets by combining tournament rank and power rank, prioritizing players strong in the heavily weighted SG OTT and SG Total categories. First-tier targets are those inside the top 10 of both ranks with elite SG OTT marks. Secondary bets target players with strong SG Total but slightly lower power ranks, provided their OTT numbers remain above the field average.

article.title: BMW Championship 2026: Model Ranks Scheffler, McIlroy, Knapp as Top Targets at Bellerive
article.dek: Tournament model places Scheffler #1, McIlroy #2, and Knapp #3 for the 50-player field at Bellerive Country Club.
article.introduction: The tournament model ranks Scottie Scheffler first with 868 SG Total and Rory McIlroy second at 785 SG Total for the BMW Championship. Jake Knapp sits third at 002 SG Total despite a power rank of 3. Course weights emphasize SG OTT at 1% and SG Total at 3%.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The BMW Championship at Bellerive Country Club features a 50-player field with course weights of SG OTT 1%, SG Total 3%, and SG PUTT 4%. The model ranks Scheffler #1, McIlroy #2, and Knapp #3 based on combined strokes-gained metrics.

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: Bellerive's 1% weight on SG OTT aligns with McIlroy's 799 SG OTT and Scheffler's 623 SG OTT. Knapp's 002 SG Total and 285 SG PUTT provide balance across the weighted categories despite lower SG OTT at 264.

sections.heading: Recent Form
sections.body: Scheffler's 868 SG Total and power rank 1 reflect consistent performance across SG OTT, SG ATG, and SG PUTT. McIlroy's 785 SG Total includes 748 SG APP, while Knapp's 002 SG Total leads the field with 285 SG PUTT.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: All three targets carry the NO_TRACKED_ROUNDS classification with zero tracked rounds in the monitored events. This classification indicates no recorded rounds rather than confirmed rest periods.

sections.heading: FedExCup Motivation
sections.body: Scheffler holds FedExCup rank #1 with SAFE_TOP_50 status. McIlroy sits at FedExCup rank #13, also SAFE_TOP_50. Knapp ranks #35 in the FedExCup standings with the same classification.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Each target shares the crossover classification of skipped Scottish Open plus top-10 model rank. Scheffler and McIlroy both carry model rank and power rank alignment at 1-1 and 2-2 respectively, while Knapp shows model rank 3 and power rank 3.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Scheffler at model rank 1 with 868 SG Total and power rank 1 represents the strongest model-supported outright target. McIlroy at model rank 2 with 785 SG Total and 799 SG OTT provides the secondary outright option.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets
sections.body: Scheffler, McIlroy, and Knapp form the top-10 card based on model ranks 1-3. Knapp's 002 SG Total and 285 SG PUTT add putting strength to the card alongside the top two model ranks.

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets
sections.body: The same three players extend to top-20 targets. Their combined model ranks 1-3 and shared crossover classification of skipped Scottish Open plus top-10 model rank provide the data-supported grouping.

sections.heading: Data Limitations
sections.body: Weather and tee-time data are not available in this pipeline. The article does not make weather- or tee-time-specific claims.

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Tier 1 model-supported targets: Scheffler and McIlroy for outright, top-5, top-10, and top-20. Tier 2 model-supported target: Knapp for top-10 and top-20.

article.conclusion: Tier 1: Scheffler (model rank 1, 868 SG Total) and McIlroy (model rank 2, 785 SG Total) for all bet types. Tier 2: Knapp (model rank 3, 002 SG Total) for top-10 and top-20 only.
